name: accentra
description: Accentra — India-focused accounting and CA-collaboration platform (MERN + TypeScript).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
